parsed.seniority_signal: 2+ years of technical leadership guiding AI/ML projects from research to production.
parsed.degree_signal: Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
parsed.notes:
Required and Nice to Have set their respective section defaults; all unmapped tools are nice-to-have.
Technical leadership supports inferred seniority despite the separate 4+ years experience requirement.
The only explicit degree level is bachelor's; 'advanced degree' does not explicitly name a master's or PhD.
Engineering principles and sequential, spatial, time-series, mesh, and simulation-output data descriptions are treated literally as domain knowledge or data types, not additional named technical skills. Time-series data does not establish a forecasting requirement.
Skills mentioned only in ABOUT THE ROLE or WHAT YOU'LL DO are not independently labeled.
